evals.prompt: 用户说：'I need better monitoring for my AI agents.' Mine the Job from this.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT treat 'better monitoring' as the Job. Notes it's a feature request/solution language. Extracts whatever behavior is present (almost none) and flags the absence of behavior as a gap. Job hypothesis is deferred or low-confidence, not fabricated.

assertions.name: Feature request not treated as a Job
assertions.description: Does not output 'Job = monitor agents'; flags 'better monitoring' as solution language, not a Job

assertions.name: No fabricated behavior
assertions.description: Does not invent a timeline, frequency, or cost not present in the one-line input

assertions.name: Missing evidence flagged
assertions.description: Reports that the input has no behavioral evidence

evals.prompt: 访谈片段：'昨天我的 Agent 跑了两个小时，最后发现是 Context 里一个参数传错了，我最后只能重新跑。' Mine it.
evals.expected_output: Extracts FACT (agent ran 2 hours, param wrong, reran). Reconstructs a partial timeline (trigger = agent failure; current workaround = rerun). Marks frequency, previous solutions, willingness to pay as Unknown — does NOT invent them.

assertions.name: FACT vs INFERENCE separated
assertions.description: Stated facts labeled FACT; any inference (e.g. 'root cause hard to trace') labeled INFERENCE, not FACT

assertions.name: Missing elements marked Unknown
assertions.description: Frequency, prior solutions, payment are listed Unknown, not fabricated

assertions.name: Timeline partial but honest
assertions.description: Reconstructs what's known; Missing Story Elements lists the gaps

evals.prompt: 一条 tweet：'Every SaaS company needs an AI agent that auto-updates their docs.' Mine it.
evals.expected_output: The product/market claim is labeled HYPOTHESIS, never FACT. No behavioral evidence is extractable from a solution assertion. Report states the Job cannot be reconstructed from this source alone.

assertions.name: Solution/market claim = HYPOTHESIS
assertions.description: 'needs an AI agent' labeled HYPOTHESIS, not FACT

assertions.name: No Job fabricated
assertions.description: Does not invent a Job from a solution assertion; says the Job is not reconstructable from this source

evals.prompt: '我一直要盯着 Agent，很烦。' Mine it — note the ambiguity.
evals.expected_output: Generates MULTIPLE Job hypotheses (know abnormal state / reduce supervision cost / intervene before failure / maintain control), not a single overconfident answer. Marks the emotional Job (control) as supported by '很烦'.

assertions.name: Multiple Job hypotheses
assertions.description: Outputs more than one Job hypothesis, not a single answer

assertions.name: Emotional Job identified
assertions.description: Identifies a control/anxiety emotional Job supported by the frustration

evals.prompt: Analyze the four forces for this source: 'I built a timeout + Slack notification because manually watching the agent was eating my day, but I'm worried an automated tool would false-positive and I'd miss real failures.'
evals.expected_output: Four forces, each tied to Evidence IDs: Push (manual watching eats the day), Pull (none clearly stated — user built their own), Habit (manual workflow), Anxiety (false positives, missing real failures). Pull may be empty — reported honestly. Opportunity map marks unknowns honestly.

assertions.name: Four forces present
assertions.description: Push/Pull/Habit/Anxiety all present, each with a statement

assertions.name: Forces tied to evidence
assertions.description: Each force statement references evidence ids; empty pull is explicit, not omitted

assertions.name: Anxiety captured
assertions.description: False-positive / miss-real-failure concern captured under Anxiety
